items.title: Tom Albert Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: Henry, me, Henry, and we used to use sometimes Kimball sometimes.

ctx.x: Henry, me, Henry, and we used to use sometimes Kimball sometimes. And then used to use John Peloton. Oh yeah. Use him sometimes. And sometimes we'd use Georgie Hooker.
Oh yeah, I've heard of it all.
